kaikki_vikisozluk.t: A disguised حَشِيش حَرَام (ḥašīš ḥarām) in the Egyptian Arabic drug slang language لغة السين (luġit is-sīn), apparently originally meaning a resemblant psychoactive plant, which can be Withania somnifera of the same tribe Physaleae.
g: Cape gooseberry (Physalis peruviana and Physalis gen. et spp.)
